A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]], '''Janet Lalasha''' was a [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Dorenian Beshniquel]] player who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Deemed to be a suspicious individual by the regime, Lalasha was subsequently persecuted and [[Death/Legends|executed]], and her [[Music/Legends|music]] was suppressed by the Imperial authorities. However, when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] rose to power years after Lalasha's [[Death/Legends|death]], a chance came for the musician's work to be heard once again.

==Biography==
Janet Lalasha was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] who was renowned as an excellent player of the [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Dorenian Beshniquel]]&mdash;better known as the [[Dorenian Beshniquel/Legends|Fizzz]]&mdash;a single reed wind instrument commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]].<ref name="wddwtbt">{{StoryCite|story=We Don't Do Weddings: The Band's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref><ref name="ebtdt">{{StoryCite|story=Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref> Lalasha lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="cswe" /> an authoritarian government that rose to power in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The Empire was a censorial regime and began systematically hunting down, [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoning]], and [[Death/Legends|executing]] many musicians and confiscating their [[Music/Legends|music]].<ref name="tlosttobf" /><ref name="ebtdt" /> Lalasha was targeted in one such purge<ref name="cswe" /> by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> as a "questionable" individual, and the musician was subsequently executed.<ref name="cswe" /> Following Lalasha's death, the Empire also purged records of her music.<ref name="tlosttobf" />

Despite the Empire's success in suppressing Lalasha's music, recordings of her work eventually came into the possession of the fugitive [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] war criminal [[Kardue'sai'Malloc/Legends|Kardue'sai'Malloc]], who admired Lalasha as a nigh-unparalleled Fizzz player.<ref name="ebtdt" /> Once Malloc was finally caught by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]<ref name="tlosttobf" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Devaronian made his captor promise to sell his music collection&mdash;including the works of Lalasha&mdash;to a contact, in the hope that it could be redistributed across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Personality and traits==
The works of Janet Lalasha&mdash;who was a skillful Dorenian Beshniquel player&mdash;were deemed to be a threat to the authoritarian regime of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="tlosttobf" /><ref name="ebtdt" />

==Behind the scenes==
Janet Lalasha was first mentioned in the short story ''[[Empire Blues: The Devaronian's Tale]]'', authored by [[Daniel Keys Moran]] and appearing in the [[1995]] ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]'' anthology book.<ref name="ebtdt" />
